facts.en: Earned a Bachelor of Arts in information management at Fictional Goldfern University in 2013.
facts.zh: 2013 年在虚构金蕨大学获得信息管理文学学士学位。

facts.en: Paid records assistant at Fictional Brightseed Foundation from 2013-09 to 2017-02.
facts.zh: 2013-09 至 2017-02 在虚构亮种基金会任有薪档案助理。

facts.en: Paid fundraising database officer at the same foundation from 2017-03 to 2021-05.
facts.zh: 2017-03 至 2021-05 在同一基金会任有薪筹款数据库专员。

facts.en: Paid data operations manager at Fictional Willowlantern Trust from 2021-06 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-06 至 2026-08 在虚构柳灯信托机构任有薪数据运营经理。

facts.en: Line-manages 4 data officers and sets weekly priorities for imports, corrections and campaign selections.
facts.zh: 直接管理 4 名数据专员，并为导入、更正及活动名单筛选设定每周优先次序。

facts.en: Maintains documented CRM import rules and checks duplicate-person candidates before approved merges.
facts.zh: 维护有文档记录的 CRM 导入规则，并在获批合并前检查疑似重复人员记录。

facts.en: Builds campaign selections from approved contact preferences, exclusions and segment definitions.
facts.zh: 依据获批联系偏好、排除条件及分群定义建立活动名单。

facts.en: The fundraising director approves appeal strategy; the information-governance lead approves retention-policy changes.
facts.zh: 筹款总监批准募捐策略；信息治理负责人批准保留政策变更。

facts.en: Managed the data workstream of a 2025-03 CRM migration with an external implementation team.
facts.zh: 2025-03 与外部实施团队合作，管理 CRM 迁移的数据工作部分。

facts.en: Personally approved reconciled import batches within delegated operational authority; the vendor configured system integrations.
facts.zh: 个人在获授运营权限范围内批准已核对导入批次；供应商配置系统集成。

facts.en: The reconciliation covered 18000 transaction records associated with 6200 distinct supporter records.
facts.zh: 核对覆盖 18000 条交易记录，关联 6200 条不同支持者记录。

facts.en: The team resolved 140 flagged mapping exceptions before import sign-off; the report does not identify all as original-data errors.
facts.zh: 团队在导入签批前解决 140 个标记的映射异常；报告未将其全部认定为原始数据错误。

facts.en: Uses CRM reporting, SQL validation queries and spreadsheet reconciliation controls.
facts.zh: 使用 CRM 报表、SQL 验证查询及电子表格核对控制。

facts.en: Presents data-quality and unresolved-access issues at monthly governance meetings.
facts.zh: 在每月治理会议汇报数据质量及未解决访问权限问题。

facts.en: Completed internal manager training on access-request handling in 2022-04.
facts.zh: 2022-04 完成有关访问请求处理的内部经理培训。

facts.en: Maintains change approvals and coordinates post-import spot checks with fundraising users.
facts.zh: 维护变更审批记录，并与筹款系统用户协调导入后抽查。

facts.en: Volunteers with Fictional Quiltlight Community Theatre, maintaining a costume-loan register.
facts.zh: 在虚构被光社区剧团做志愿者，维护服装借用登记册。

facts.en: Created a personal illustrated calendar in 2024 for family use, with no fundraising sales campaign.
facts.zh: 2024 年制作个人插画日历供家人使用，不涉及筹款销售活动。

facts.en: Enjoys solving logic grids and making hand-stitched notebook covers.
facts.zh: 爱好解逻辑方格谜题及手缝笔记本封套。

facts.en: Coaches data officers on reconciliation evidence and records development goals during regular one-to-one meetings.
facts.zh: 指导数据专员整理核对证据，并在定期一对一会议中记录发展目标。
